subject: Rule: every user-facing string goes through ui_copy — add the key to config/app_config.yaml AND REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS, regenerate packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json, read it with useUiText()/uiText()
body: From S05f (5af5120). Regenerate defaults with: UPDATE_UI_COPY_DEFAULTS=1 uv run pytest tests/config_api/test_ui_copy_defaults.py (CI fails if stale). No hard-coded product copy in apps/web (design-system specimens on /system excepted).
